annotations.title: Add a contact to a pipeline

description: Create a pipeline item (deal, lead...) on a contact in a given pipeline and status, with an optional note. Returns { PipelineItemId }. LACRM: CreatePipelineItem.

contact_id.description: The contact or company id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

note.description: Optional note shown in the item's history.

pipeline_id.description: The pipeline id (from lacrm_list_pipelines) (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

run_status_automation.description: Run the status's automation. Default false.

status_id.description: The starting status id (from the pipeline's Statuses) (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

name: lacrm_create_pipeline_item
title: Add a contact to a pipeline
